تستقوا (form VIII)

# تُسْتَقَوْا (tustaqaw) /tus.ta.qaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقَى (istaqā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
